domain_focus: MAVEN-ERE: frozen high-recall v1.4 event inventory; sparse and precision-oriented CAUSE/PRECONDITION relation induction.
abstraction_level: Layer 1 is frozen/reused from v1.4 when available. Layer 2 consolidates clear coreference only for reasoning, proposes sparse dependency edges globally, then requires definition-specific verification and a skeptic.
population_policy: Preserve all v1.4 event mentions. Do not enumerate all local event pairs. Relation edges must survive a sparse global proposal, a strict MAVEN definition test, and an independent false-positive skeptic. Gold remains unavailable until post-L12 evaluation.
event_modeling_preference: Use the shortest complete exact trigger; retain genuine multi-token predicates such as took place; do not conflate entity mentions with events.

negative_examples.text: A relation inferred only from world knowledge with no document support.
